title: PREPARE: The Bailout is Coming.
speaker: Kevin Paffrath

macro_themes.theme: Berkshire may fund Meta's AI raise
macro_themes.view: A Berkshire convertible-preferred deal with Meta (like Alphabet's) would signal AI stocks are cheap and could spark big AI buying.
Hedge-fund net leverage at 5-year lows and cheaper forward P/Es are a contrarian buy signal.
Rising credit spreads and CDS on AI spenders make debt costly, pushing companies to equity raises.
Bloom and Western Digital earnings hint the AI buildout is nowhere near its peak.
Expects a post-midterm rally, the Fed to hold, and is bullish on an Iran deal.
